mission_07: A scaling matrix is diagonal: [[sx, 0], [0, sy]].
A shear matrix (shear x by y) is [[1, k], [0, 1]].
Combined transformation: shear @ scaling @ rotation (right-to-left order).
To transform points stored as rows: (combined @ points.T).T.
The determinant of a rotation is always 1 (preserves area).
